records.verification_note: Read live 2026-09-29. Five-justice Constitutional Court, unanimous, 17 Mar 2026: the whole Computer Misuse (Amendment) Act 2022 is void because Parliament passed it without ascertaining quorum (Rule 24(3) of the Rules of Procedure; Articles 88-89 of the Constitution). records.jurisdiction: Global; EEA users of Google tags
records.title: Consent mode reference (ad_storage, analytics_storage, ad_user_data, ad_personalization)
records.scope: Behaviour of Google tags per consent parameter; addressed to Google tag users receiving data from EEA end users
records.uncertainty: Page states no deadline; the March 2024 EEA enforcement date stays partial (see GOOGLE-CONSENT-MODE-GA4-2026).
records.verification_note: Read live 2026-09-29 (benchmark S08): four parameters; ad_user_data denied disables use of personal data for online advertising, including user_id cases; ad_storage denied means no new advertising cookies and IP truncation at collection; analytics_storage denied sends cookieless pings used for modelling.

records.title: Consent mode overview (basic and advanced)
records.scope: Implementation behaviour of consent mode
records.uncertainty: Page does not state legal requirements; region defaults and url_passthrough were not read on this page.
records.verification_note: Read live 2026-09-29: basic mode blocks Google tags until the banner interaction and sends nothing before consent; advanced mode loads tags with denied defaults and sends consent state and cookieless measurements; advanced feeds an advertiser-specific model, basic a general model.

records.title: Behavioural modelling for consent mode
records.scope: Eligibility thresholds for GA4 behavioural modelling
records.uncertainty: Meeting the thresholds does not guarantee eligibility (further model quality criteria apply).
records.verification_note: Read live 2026-09-29: at least 1,000 events per day with analytics_storage denied for at least 7 days, and at least 1,000 daily users with analytics_storage granted for at least 7 of the previous 28 days; tags must load before the consent dialog; reporting identity must be Blended.

records.title: About enhanced conversions
use_for: enhanced conversions for web and for leads
records.scope: Definition, hashing and normalisation of enhanced conversions
records.uncertainty: Setup routes (Google tag, GTM, API, Data Manager) were not read on this page; customer data policy compliance stays with the advertiser.
records.verification_note: Read live 2026-09-29 (benchmark S09): SHA-256 hashed email, name, home address and phone; normalise first (trim whitespace, lowercase, E.164 phone, remove periods in gmail/googlemail addresses); two types: web, and leads (with offline conversion import).

records.title: Handling duplicate Pixel and Conversions API events
records.scope: Deduplication keys and window
records.uncertainty: Behaviour when browser and server payloads differ meaningfully is not specified beyond 'generally prefer the event received first'.
records.verification_note: Read live 2026-09-29 (benchmark S10): match event_id (server) to eventID (Pixel) and event_name to event; events are deduplicated only if received within 48 hours; the alternative fbp and/or external_id method works only for browser-first-then-server events; Meta recommends a redundant Pixel plus Conversions API setup.

records.title: Conversions API server event and customer information parameters
records.scope: event_time, action_source, event_id, event_source_url, and hashing of customer information parameters
records.uncertainty: Customer-information rules were read on the companion page /parameters/customer-information-parameters the same day.
records.verification_note: Read live 2026-09-29: event_time up to 7 days before sending; action_source required (email, website, app, phone_call, chat, physical_store, system_generated, business_messaging, other); event_source_url required for website events; hash em, ph, fn, ln, db, ge, ct, st, zp and country with SHA-256 after normalising (phone with country code, no leading zeros); never hash client_ip_address, client_user_agent, fbc, fbp or ctwa_clid.

records.title: Server-side tagging overview
records.scope: What server-side tagging is, hosting and cost
records.uncertainty: Costs are Google's indicative figures; non-Google hosting was not assessed.
records.verification_note: Read live 2026-09-29 (benchmark S11): moves tag instrumentation to a server container on Cloud Run (automatic provisioning) or other hosting; the default single-server deployment is usually free within the free tier; upgraded deployments typically cost USD 30-50 per server per month; at least 3 instances per container recommended for production; a custom subdomain lets the server set HttpOnly first-party cookies.

records.title: BigQuery Export
records.scope: Export types, limits and cost
records.uncertainty: BigQuery storage and query pricing beyond streaming is not stated on this page.
records.verification_note: Read live 2026-09-29 (benchmark S12): standard properties' daily export up to 1M events per day (filter to stay under); 360 up to 20B; streaming export for both, with no completeness SLO and excluding new-user and new-session traffic source; streaming costs USD 0.05 per GB (about 600,000 events per GB); fresh daily export is 360 only.

records.title: Data retention

records.title: Uganda regulator clarifies requirements for offshore entities

use_for: cross-border transfer records for analytics and ad platforms
records.scope: PDPO decision of 18 July 2025 as reported
records.uncertainty: Secondary law-firm report; the PDPO decision text was not read. Not legal advice.
records.verification_note: Read live 2026-09-29 (benchmark E15): entities handling personal data of Ugandan citizens must register (reported fee UGX 100,000); no advance approval per transfer, but records of the legal basis, safeguards and justification for cross-border transfers must be kept for inspection; a lawful transfer needs consent or an equivalent-protection destination.
